description.value:
Activation: 8

What is foreseen cannot be flanked.

At the start of each round, an ally that begins its turn on one of your Ordained Ground squares gains temporary HP equal to your tier. While an ally stands on an Ordained Ground square, attacks against that ally cannot benefit from advantage.

BulwarkGuard0000.description: Fate (Olvarra). 2bX — ONE config rule, both mechanics (Always Active, so no use event exists; config is fine because two engine sweeps read it): the legacy-marker turn-start pass reads thpFormula (Temp HP = tier for an ally beginning its turn on the owner's Ordained square — was `edhaOwnsTalent(owner, "Bulwark Ground")`, rule 2b's exact smell), and the defender-keyed pre-roll injector reads noAdvantage (attacks against an ally standing on the owner's square can't benefit from advantage — the inverse of edha-unseen-ward; announced via edhaWatchersOfRule, no name anywhere).

ForeknownSpring0.description: Fate (Olvarra). 2bX — ENGINE-OWNED marker-command flow keyed on this rule: posts the scene card with a spring button per unsprung snare; a click springs it at its own centre for +THIS document's damage formula ([T][D] — pre-2bX the bonus was a hard-coded module constant). The ally free-action election stays MANUAL as declared (no hook can force another creature's action) and rides the card note. Drift note (2bX, one line): the old code also wrote a `fateForeknown` scene flag that NOTHING ever read — dropped, not migrated.

HexmarkReact0000.description: Fate (Olvarra). 2bX — ONE config rule, both mechanics (was two name-keyed sites: the offer at the spring and the applyDamage rider): when one of YOUR snares springs, the resolver sweeps this rule and posts the Reaction offer; the click writes markedBy.hexmark (the Diagnosed/Omen marked pattern). The applyDamage PRE-pass then reads the SAME rule off the mark: the marked foe takes +@tier keen whenever it takes damage within 10 ft of your Ordained Ground / unsprung Snares (added to the in-flight apply, no recursion). Scene cleanup clears every mark key an offer-mark rule names.

InevAnnotate0000.description: Fate (Olvarra). 2bX — H3ann: flag your MOST RECENT un-flagged snare `inevitable` (the Sealed-Edict/Pinpoint shape; 'no snare left to flag' refuses BEFORE the 1 Investiture is charged). The annotate stamps sourceItemUuid, so the spring resolver reads the +[T][D] extra die off THIS document's damage formula (pre-2bX it rolled a module constant — the silent editability bug: editing this talent's damage changed nothing) and the contest off the rider fields here: the triggering foe rolls riderSkill vs your riderColor (engine-rolled, iron rule 3) and takes riderFailStatus on a fail.

OrdainedZone0000.description: Fate (Olvarra). 2bX — the placement as the generic zone verb (was the preUseItem takeover): click-place a 5 ft marker square within Green Attunement Range (the range gate is new with 2bX — the card always said 'in Attunement Range' and the takeover never checked it; card-is-spec, §9m q11). Cap = tier, the oldest fizzles (Ben R1). The system charges the 1 Investiture; a cancelled or out-of-range pick REFUNDS it. Writes the `ordained` H3 ledger (flags.edha-content.lists.ordained) — REPOINTED in 2bAA, the sixth and last ledger of the migration; entries are point-bound, so H3's mark-wins reconcile fails open and keeps them (the 2bV covenants convention). The +1-defenses turn-start buff, the Aid-at-30-ft grant and the picker/canvas stay ENGINE-OWNED, keyed on this rule.

SnareZone0000000.description: Fate (Olvarra). 2bX — click-place a 5 ft snare square within Green Attunement Range (cap = tier, oldest fizzles; cancel/out-of-range refunds the 1 Investiture the system charged). The trap's damage formula and type ride THIS document ([T][D] + Awareness keen — edit them on the Details tab and the spring rolls what you wrote). The entry lands on the `snares` H3 ledger (lists.snares — REPOINTED 2bX): point-bound, no uuid, no marker status, so H3's reconcile keeps every entry (fail-open, the covenants convention). The green template + the invisible enter/pass-through trigger Region stay ENGINE-OWNED (§9o), keyed on this rule; springing deals the damage + Restrained and consumes the snare.

Cost: 3 Investiture

It will happen. The world has not yet noticed.

Spend 3 Investiture and declare a specific event that will happen during this scene — a character drops to 0 HP, a particular enemy crosses a threshold, an ally reaches a designated location, or the GM raises the stakes. The first time the declared event occurs during the scene, every Ordained Ground square you have active grants its standing ally a free Strike or Aid against the nearest enemy within 30 ft, and every unsprung Snare you have active triggers in its space, treating the center as the triggering character. Once per scene.

Cost: 2 Investiture

Two threads. One knot. The shears will choose them together.

Spend 2 Investiture and choose two of your active Ordained Ground squares within Attunement Range. For the scene, their fates are linked: an ally standing on either linked square may use the Aid action as a Free Action once per round, and when an enemy triggers any Snare within 30 ft of either linked square, an ally standing on either linked square may make a free Reactive Strike against the triggering enemy.

WeaveLink0000000.description: Fate (Olvarra). 2bX — the link verb (`edha-zone {kind: link-markers}`): the player CHOOSES the two Ordained squares in the dialog (card-is-spec, §9m q11 — the retired takeover silently linked the two most recent with no picker; squares beyond Green Attunement Range are annotated in the picker, range stays owner-judged as before). Needs two active squares BEFORE cost; cancel refunds. Writes the `linked` annotation the spring watch below reads — pre-2bX that annotation had one write and zero reads.

handler.note: An ally on either linked square may Aid as a Free Action (once/round), and linked squares watch every nearby Snare spring (GM/players execute the granted actions).

WeaveSpringWatch.description: Fate (Olvarra). 2bX — the spring watch (config; was described once at cast time and never again, because the spring path had no Weave branch — worse than manual, and the spring path IS a nameable hook, iron rule 3): when one of your snares springs within 30 ft of a LINKED square, the resolver posts the Reactive-Strike prompt below. The grant itself stays MANUAL as declared (Foundry cannot force another creature's action).

handler.note: an ally standing on either linked square may make a free Reactive Strike against the triggering enemy (GM/players execute).
